steps.output:
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 8]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    visible = [c for c in range(w) if not c0 <= c <= c1]
    out = []
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        matches = [s for s in range(h) if s != r and all(grid[s][c] == grid[r][c] for c in visible)]
        source_row = next((s for s in matches if all(grid[s][c] != 8 for c in range(c0, c1 + 1))), None)
        row = []
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            row.append(grid[source_row][c] if source_row is not None else grid[c][r])
        out.append(row)
    return out
